_comment: Craftspace MCP for Cursor. Put this at ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) or <project>/.cursor/mcp.json. Cursor supports remote HTTP MCP with headers and ${env:VAR} interpolation. For humans, OAuth on first connect is simplest (drop the headers block and sign in when prompted); the token form below suits headless use. Set CRAFTSPACE_TOKEN to a cst_… member token.
